queries.query: "large language model" AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR "network operations")
queries.rationale: Locate primary research that applies LLMs directly to generating or translating network configurations or NetOps tasks to establish the current state of LLM→config work.

queries.query: ("LLM" OR "large language model" OR "generative model") AND (repair OR "configuration repair" OR "config repair" OR "iterative repair") AND (network OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Find literature on iterative repair, generate–repair, and self-correction specifically applied to network configuration outputs to study failure modes and repair mechanisms.

queries.query: "generate and verify" OR "generate-then-verify" AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR "network configuration" OR Batfish OR Veriflow)
queries.rationale: Discover work that combines generative models with external verifiers/validators (e.g., Batfish, Veriflow) to enforce semantic correctness of network actions.

queries.query: Batfish OR Veriflow OR Anteater OR "network configuration verification" "reachability" ACL firewall router
queries.rationale: Survey established deterministic/network-analysis tools and research (Batfish, Veriflow, etc.) to understand available validators and their semantic coverage for configuration correctness checks.

queries.query: "intent-based networking" OR "intent to configuration" OR "intent translation" AND (network OR NetOps OR "intent-based")
queries.rationale: Locate research on formalizing operator intent and mapping to configurations; helps define the phenomenon of intent translation and associated correctness challenges.

queries.query: AIOps OR "AI for Operations" OR "NetOps benchmark" OR "network operations benchmark" OR "NetOps dataset"
queries.rationale: Identify benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation suites for AIOps/NetOps to evaluate benchmark validity and gaps relevant to LLM assessment.

queries.query: "LLM" OR "large language model" AND (safety OR reliability OR "operational safety" OR "automation hazards") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network operations")
queries.rationale: Gather literature on safety/reliability concerns when deploying LLM-driven automation in operational contexts to inform mitigations and threat models.

queries.query: "tool-augmented" OR "tool-use" OR "tool-assisted" OR Toolformer OR ReAct OR Reflexion OR "self-correction" AND (LLM OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Collect mechanisms and architectures for tool use, verification, and LLM self-correction that can be adapted to network validators and repair loops.

queries.query: "autonomous agent" OR agentic OR "agentic AI" AND (operations OR NetOps OR "network operations" OR orchestration)
queries.rationale: Explore agentic frameworks and orchestration systems (LangChain, AutoGen, custom agents) for building multi-step NetOps workflows and their safety controls.

queries.query: "network emulator" OR Mininet OR ns-3 OR Emulab OR CloudLab AND (benchmark OR evaluation OR "network experiments")
queries.rationale: Find experimental platforms and testbeds used for NetOps evaluation to assess feasibility of realistic execution, validation, and reproducibility in experiments.

queries.query: "formal methods" AND (network OR "network configuration" OR routing OR reachability) AND (SMT OR "model checking" OR verification)
queries.rationale: Survey formal-methods approaches (SMT, model checking) applied to networks to understand strong semantic validators versus heuristic checks.

queries.query: "YANG" OR "network as code" OR "infrastructure as code" OR Ansible OR Terraform AND (network OR NetOps OR "configuration management")
queries.rationale: Identify configuration languages, IaC patterns, and operational toolchains to ground LLM outputs in real-world syntactic/semantic constraints and datasets.

queries.query: "program synthesis" OR "code generation" OR "semantic correctness" AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (configuration OR "network configuration")
queries.rationale: Locate work on program synthesis and semantic correctness guarantees for generated code/configurations that can inform methods for LLM→config correctness.

queries.query: "evaluation metrics" OR "operational correctness" OR "semantic correctness" OR "safety metrics" AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (NetOps OR network)
queries.rationale: Search for metric definitions and methodology papers proposing how to measure correctness, safety, and operational impact of automated NetOps actions.

queries.query: "human-in-the-loop" OR "human oversight" OR "operator approval" AND (NetOps OR "network operations" OR automation)
queries.rationale: Collect literature on human-AI collaboration and guardrails in operational domains to evaluate mitigation strategies and approval workflows.

queries.query: "adversarial" OR "attack" OR "security risk" AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "misconfiguration")
queries.rationale: Identify research on adversarial threats and security risks where LLM-generated network artifacts could be exploited or cause vulnerabilities.

inclusion_criteria: arXiv and other open-access preprints with verifiable authorship and links to code/datasets when available.
Technical reports, whitepapers, and tool documentation (Batfish, Veriflow, Mininet) that are publicly accessible and technically substantive.
Public datasets, benchmark descriptions, and GitHub repositories with reproducible artifacts and documentation.
Standards and specifications relevant to NetOps (IETF RFCs, YANG modules) when they inform operational semantics.
exclusion_criteria: Unverified blog posts or opinion pieces without technical details or references (unless they link to primary sources).
Social-media posts (Twitter/X threads) and paywalled items with no accessible abstract or metadata to verify claims.
Works outside the NetOps/AIOps/automation scope unless they provide transferable methods (e.g., general LLM safety papers should still be relevant to operations).
Proprietary datasets or internal vendor-only tools that cannot be inspected or referenced publicly.
date_rationale: Prioritize recent work (roughly 2018–2026) because LLM and agentic-AI methods have evolved rapidly since ~2018; include earlier seminal papers for formal methods, network verification, and intent-based networking (pre-2018) to ground validators and semantics. Include the most recent preprints and tool releases up to 2026 to ensure coverage of the latest LLM→NetOps approaches.
